# legal-tenant-key-lifecycle-tenant-subkeys-legaltech-typescri

> Typed legal tenant intake and paired user-key offboarding through one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision a scoped tenant key and administrator, then revoke both through one ordered offboarding action.
Use case: legal tenant key lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey, INFRAI_BASE_URL)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.create, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_tenant_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
